text:
The Rangers arrive on a three-game winning streak, the latest a 4-3 win at SEA two days ago, but they are without Alberts Smits and Sean Durzi. With Durzi out, Braden Schneider has moved in beside Pettersson and is up to 20:22 a night from 18:11, while Adam Fox is up to 24:32 from 22:46. The Oilers beat VAN 4-2 on Saturday, when Filip Hronek reached 300 career points, and they are missing Colton Dach and Isaac Howard. NYR lost 4-1 to EDM on Nov 1, a game Edmonton deserved to win 58% of the time.

Our numbers say this is closer than that result suggests. At five on five, NYR has taken 52% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) in its games and EDM 49%. Edmonton's results have run ahead of its chances, with finishing doing much of the lifting. The Oilers also take 4.1 penalties a game, which keeps handing opponents power plays. We have the Rangers at 48% to win, above DraftKings' 41%. In net, projected starter Dylan Garand is +2.2 goals saved above expected this season (saves beyond what the shot quality predicts), while projected Devon Levi is at -1.1.

For the Rangers, Alexis Lafrenière (28% to score, 55% for a point) went first overall in 2020, and CBS Sports noted he slid two helpers in Saturday's win. Pavel Dorofeyev leads the team at 29% to score. For the Oilers, Leon Draisaitl is at 49% to score and has goals in three straight games, and Connor McDavid brings an 18-game point streak and a 93% chance of a point.
